crossRefs.note: After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his sickness was so severe that…
All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”
They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.
So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

translations.web: When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and lying on his bed.
translations.bsb: When Elisha reached the house, there was the boy lying dead on his bed.
translations.kjv: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.
translations.asv: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.
